sources.title: Treaty records of Japan-Russia relations: 1875 Sakhalin-Kuril Exchange Treaty
sources.institution: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.coverage: Signing, ratification and exchange of ratifications for the 1875 Treaty of Saint Petersburg; territorial exchange of Sakhalin/Kuril rights
sources.notes: Japanese MFA records signing on 7 May 1875 and exchange of ratifications in Tokyo on 22 August 1875.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1878 — San Stefano and Berlin treaty documents
sources.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.coverage: Official diplomatic publication of the San Stefano preliminaries, ratification exchange chronology, Treaty of Berlin and its ratification procès-verbal
sources.notes: FRUS records San Stefano ratifications exchanged at St Petersburg on 17 March 1878 and reproduces the Berlin ratification procès-verbal dated 3 August 1878.
